label: 달토끼의 우주 여행
prompt: Use case: illustration-story. ONE full-bleed 16:9 landscape slide background, 1536x864, premium children's book gouache illustration. Enchanting outer space in deep navy and indigo with delicate lavender nebula glow at edges. A small friendly white rabbit in a round astronaut helmet sitting on a golden crescent moon at the lower-left corner; a tiny original toy-like rocket and a peach ringed planet at far upper-right. Small planets and sparse tiny stars only along perimeter. Center 60 percent is smooth dark ink-blue, quiet unoccupied space with very subtle paper texture for WHITE text added later. Lovely hand-painted tactile texture, poetic luminous moonlight, meticulous detailed edge subjects, appealing to children without looking babyish. Keep all central area x22–78%, y20–72% dark and uncluttered, NO stars through that region. No letters, numbers, words, logos, watermark, borders, UI, sample text or collage. No franchise references. Opaque.
inspection: 직접 관찰: 토끼와 달 왼쪽 하단, 중앙 짙은 남색 여백, 흰색 글씨 권장. 글자·워터마크 없음.
